name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle & Retention Marketing | Automated Flows, Segmentation, Testing & QA
summary: Lifecycle marketer who owns the strategy and builds the flows myself, no agency handoff. At Solenzo I designed a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering welcome, post-purchase onboarding, review requests, long-term nurture, and reactivation of lapsed customers, segmented on behavior and lifecycle stage. I build the trigger logic and custom tracking events, monitor for broken automation, and connect results to conversion in GA4 and CRM reporting.

experience.title: Lifecycle & CRM Marketing Lead — Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architected a 20+ workflow lifecycle system: capture and welcome, qualification, booking confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term nurture and reactivation, and review generation.
Design segmentation, lifecycle stages, and scoring on customer behavior and engagement, and personalize messaging using AI-scored signals.
Build monitoring and evaluation loops that catch broken or underperforming automation logic before customers see it.
Build custom GA4 conversion events, triggers, and variables in Google Tag Manager, validated in Preview mode and browser developer tools.
Write the email copy and sequences myself and build dashboards tying funnel progression to campaign ROI.

Built campaign reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, with optimization recommendations.
